overviewText: Follow appeals and help make work better.
title: Title
fileHint: Up to 5 files, 10 MB each: PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT, DOCX, XLSX.

author: Author
commentPlaceholder: Add information or ask a question…

resultsText: Resolutions and actions for completed appeals.

errors.invalidLogin: Invalid credentials or sign-in temporarily limited.
errors.unauthorized: Session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.conflict: Another participant changed this appeal. Refresh it and try again.
errors.invalidTransition: Invalid status transition or missing reason.
errors.noChanges: There are no changes to save.
errors.selfBlock: You cannot block yourself or remove your admin role.
errors.lastAdmin: At least one active administrator is required.
errors.fileSize: Each file must be between 1 byte and 10 MB.
errors.fileCount: An appeal can have at most five attachments.
errors.serverError: Request failed. Please try again later.

anonymousHint: Your name is hidden from participants. Your department is visible; the system retains ownership for access. Avoid identifying yourself in text or files.
confirmDiscussionDelete: Delete all discussion messages? History and attachments will be retained.
dropFiles: Drop files here or paste with Ctrl+V. Up to 5 files, 10 MB each.
guideCreate: Choose New request, select a category and describe your question.
guideDiscuss: Find replies and files in the request discussion. Changes appear automatically; the bell shows notifications.
guideFinish: When satisfied, close your request and rate the response. Set a reminder to return later.
confirmDeleteUser: Delete this user? Access will be disabled and open assignments returned to the queue. The account can be restored.
